module_failed: The virtual camera module could not be loaded: %s
module_loading: The virtual camera is not loaded. Asking for permission to load it.
module_not_built: The virtual camera module (v4l2loopback) is not built for the running kernel (%s). Install the kernel's headers, then run: sudo dkms autoinstall
no_answer_wifi: No phone answered at %s. Open the DroidCam app on the phone, and check that the phone and this computer are on the same network.
no_device: The virtual camera module is loaded but no camera named "%s" appeared. Remove the module and load it again: sudo modprobe -r v4l2loopback && sudo modprobe v4l2loopback
no_phone_usb: No phone found on USB. Plug the phone in with its cable and turn on USB debugging in its developer options.
no_program: %s is not installed. Install the entry "Phone as a camera" again in Stereo APTus.
offline: The phone is connected but does not answer. Unplug the cable, plug it in again and unlock the phone.
secure_boot: Secure Boot refused the virtual camera module: it is signed with a key this computer does not trust yet. Restart and approve the edition's key when the blue screen asks, or turn Secure Boot off in the firmware.
several_phones: More than one phone is connected (%s). Unplug the others, or start again with ANDROID_SERIAL set to one of these.
unauthorized: The phone has not allowed this computer. Look at the phone's screen and tap Allow on the USB debugging question.
